datasets.name: ResultDatSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT  
    region_name, 
    sum(generalamt),
case when  sum(avgamt)=0 then 
 0 else (sum(avgamt)/sum(generalamt))*100 end as
    avgamt,

    sum(natvalamt),
case when  sum(avgnatvalamt)=0 then 
   0 else 
 (sum(avgnatvalamt)/sum(natvalamt))*100 end as avgnatvalamt,

   sum(freevalamt), 
case when  sum(avgfreevalamt)=0 then 
   0 else ( sum(avgfreevalamt)/sum(freevalamt))*100 end as avgfreevalamt ,
    sum(um_sdv_mv),
case when  sum(um_sdv_orta)=0 then 
    0 else (sum(um_sdv_orta)/sum(um_sdv_mv))*100 end as um_sdv_orta,
   sum(expiresamt),
   sum(rest),
case when sum(intrest_orta)=0 then
    0 else 
  (sum(intrest_orta)/sum(rest))*100 end as intrest_orta,
    sum(rest_mv),
case when sum(rest_mv)=0 and sum(intrest_orta_mv)=0 then 
     0 else 
    (sum(intrest_orta_mv)/sum(rest_mv))*100 end as intrest_orta_mv,
    sum(rest_sdv),
case when  sum(int_sdv_orta)=0 then
     0 else 
    (sum(int_sdv_orta)/sum(rest_sdv))*100 end as int_sdv_orta
  
  FROM cm_n2_sdt
  group by region_name

datasets.name: CrdinfoDatSet
datasets.sql:
select id,currency,customertype,branchid ,(duedatefirstcontract - dateofconclusion) as period
from  CM_portfolio

datasets.name: PeriodDatSet
datasets.sql:
select period from (
select 
 (duedatefirstcontract - dateofconclusion) as period
from cm_portfolio
order  by (duedatefirstcontract - dateofconclusion))
group by period
